comparison.objective: Join a shelf to a cabinet side using two cam-and-bolt connectors.
comparison.physical_skill: Orient cams with screwdrivers, align a shelf simultaneously to bolts and dowels, push it square, regrip and turn both cams tight.
comparison.success_condition: Both bolt heads enter, both cams lock and draw the joint below the gap limit, tools return, and closed-cam forcing causes no damage.
comparison.reason: It shares screwdriver seating, regripped rotation, and locking, but its central tested ability is multi-connector panel alignment and eccentric joint closure. The candidate instead unlocks one adjustable device, reacquires a moved socket, and iteratively tunes dynamic stopping performance.
